day: # The Church of England's Daily Eucharistic Lectionary: Table 6 of the
# Common Worship Weekday Lectionary (2005, second impression 2010), read
# from the Church of England's PDF (October 2026).  A two-year cycle in
# Ordinary Time: cycle 1 and 2 (Year 1 begins with Advent 2026, 2028 ...;
# 2025-26 is Year 2, as the table of lectionary years 2020-2045 gives it);
# rows with no cycle are the same in both years.  Advent 1 Monday's first
# reading follows the Sunday year (A; B and C).  For the Common Worship
# Keys: Advent and Lent by their Sundays (Advent 3 only before 17 Dec);
# 17-23 Dec, 29-31 Dec and 2-5 Jan by date (not on a Sunday; 24 Dec is the
# Christmas Eve service in cw.csv); 7-12 Jan until the Baptism; DEL Weeks
# 1-9 from the Monday after the Baptism (the Sunday after 6 January) until
# Ash Wednesday; the days after Ash Wednesday; the weeks of Easter (none
# on Ascension Day); and after Pentecost the weeks by the dates of their
# Sundays ("Wk beg 10-14 May" = the week of the Sunday 8-14 May) through
# DEL Week 34.  Holy Week has no weekday provision (cw.csv gives it).  The
# readings that may replace the day's in the third, fourth and fifth weeks
# of Lent are a set of their own, "(alternative)".
# Kinds by book: ot (Old Testament and Apocrypha), nt, psalm (with
# canticles), gospel.  "end" (Isaiah 4:2-end) is kept as printed: the
# source gives no verse.  Misprints corrected from the parallel entry
# (DEL Weeks 6-9 are printed twice, before Lent and after Pentecost) or the
# Lk 14, 15-24, Mk 12; .28-34, "Ps 116; 10-15" and like semicolons inside
# printed order.  Small differences between the two printings of DEL
